sourceDocuments.title: Artemisinin Combination Therapies in Uncomplicated Falciparum Malaria
sourceDocuments.text: Artemether-lumefantrine provides rapid parasite clearance times and high cure rates exceeding ninety-five percent in pediatric clinical trials conducted across West Africa.

studentDocument.title: Antimalarial Policy and Chemotherapeutic Efficacy
studentDocument.text: Contemporary guidelines prioritize artemisinin derivative combinations for uncomplicated malaria. Clinical researchers have evaluated fixed-dose therapies with variable outcomes in community health centers. Pharmacovigilance networks report sustained efficacy throughout endemic tropical zones.
